Wizards Black Star Promos

Released July 1, 1999 · 53 cards

Wizards Black Star Promos is a Pokémon TCG expansion in the Base series, released in English on July 1, 1999. It has 53 cards. It includes 49 Pokémon, 4 Trainer and 0 Energy cards, and is not legal in Standard or Expanded.

Illustrators

20 illustrators worked on Wizards Black Star Promos. Most cards: Ken Sugimori (14), Atsuko Nishida (6), Toshinao Aoki (6), Kagemaru Himeno (5), Keiji Kinebuchi (3), "Big Mama" Tagawa (2), Hironobu Yoshida (2), Mitsuhiro Arita (2).
